name: D01 the replay window becomes one-sided
guards: a capture replayed with a FUTURE timestamp is refused too

name: D02 the window edge moves by one second
guards: exactly maxAgeSeconds is accepted and one past it is refused

name: D03 the signed message is body + timestamp
guards: the construction is Discord's order, joined to Discord's own library rather than to this adapter's signer

name: D04 the timestamp is left out of the signed message
guards: the timestamp is SIGNED, so moving it inside the window is refused by cryptography

name: D05 an unparseable timestamp is reported INVALID
guards: STALE and INVALID stay two operator actions

name: D06 a blank header counts as present
guards: a whitespace-only signature header is ABSENT, not a malformed signature
from: return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "" ? value : null;
to: return typeof value === "string" && value !== "" ? value : null;

name: D07 the parsed-key cache ignores which key it holds
guards: a rotated key takes effect on the next delivery

name: D08 the signature grammar check is removed
guards: trailing garbage after a genuine signature is refused, not truncated away by Buffer.from

name: D09 the public-key grammar check is removed
guards: a configured key with a trailing typo is not silently truncated into the genuine key

name: D10 the SPKI prefix names a different key length
guards: the raw-key wrapping is proven by RFC 8032 rather than by a second copy of itself

name: D11 the PING is answered with the wrong callback type
guards: the handshake echo is exactly PONG
from: export const DISCORD_PONG_BODY = JSON.stringify({ type: DISCORD_CALLBACK_TYPE.PONG });

name: D12 PONG is mistranscribed in vendor.ts
guards: the vendor numbers are joined to Discord's own library enums

name: D13 the PING arm is deleted
guards: a PING is a handshake, never an ignorable delivery
from: if (type === DISCORD_INTERACTION_TYPE.PING) return ok(shape("handshake", verifiedBody, DISCORD_PONG_BODY));

name: D14 a thread is keyed on itself
guards: a channel routing rule for the parent matches inside its threads

name: D15 announcement threads stop being threads
guards: all three documented thread channel types key under their parent

name: D16 the bot guard is deleted
guards: a bot-invoked command never starts a turn

name: D17 a command with no id is admitted
guards: no inbox row without the provider's idempotency key

name: D18 a non-snowflake channel id becomes an address
guards: a hostile channel id never becomes a key segment

name: D19 command text stops descending into sub-commands
guards: a sub-command's option values are the text

name: D20 context-menu commands start turns
guards: only CHAT_INPUT commands are messages

name: D21 the snowflake grammar admits any segment
guards: nothing that is not a snowflake becomes a REST path segment

name: D22 a thread reply is posted to the parent channel
guards: a Discord thread is a channel and the reply goes into it

name: D23 a reset socket is treated as never connected
guards: a connection lost AFTER the far side read the request is INDETERMINATE

name: D24 403 is reported as a dead credential
guards: Missing Permissions on one channel does not send the refresh fence to re-authorize

name: D25 a 5xx on a write is retried
guards: a write the far side may have performed is RECONCILE

name: D26 a timed-out write is retried
guards: a request written and never answered is INDETERMINATE

name: D27 a 429 forgets the wait Discord asked for
guards: retryAfterSeconds carries Discord's Retry-After / retry_after

name: D28 the bucket gate never refuses
guards: a request on an exhausted bucket never leaves the process
from:
if (until > at) {
      return { admitted: false, retryAfterSeconds: wholeSeconds(until - at), reason: "bucket exhausted" };
to:
if (until < 0) {
      return { admitted: false, retryAfterSeconds: wholeSeconds(until - at), reason: "bucket exhausted" };

name: D29 the shorter of two waits wins
guards: the LATER of Retry-After and retry_after is honoured

name: D30 a bucket is not split by top-level resource
guards: one busy channel does not silence another

name: D31 X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 on a success is ignored
guards: the client stops before Discord has to refuse

name: D32 a global 429 is treated as an ordinary bucket 429
guards: a GLOBAL limit holds every route for that bot, not only the route that was refused

name: D33 every credential shares one rate-limit identity
guards: two bots never throttle each other

name: D34 a followup presents the bot authorization scheme
guards: the interaction token in the path is the only authorization a followup sends

name: D35 the deadline timer is not cleared
guards: no per-call timer outlives its call

name: D36 mention parsing is left on
guards: an echoed @everyone notifies nobody

name: D37 wait=true is dropped from a followup create
guards: a followup answers with the created message so it can be edited

name: D38 an unreadable success body is treated as success
guards: a proxy's 200 HTML page on a read is not Discord confirming the token

name: D39 deliveredAt is the wall clock
guards: the delivered instant is the one Discord's snowflake encodes

name: D40 the documented User-Agent is not sent
guards: Discord's HTTP API requires DiscordBot ($url, $versionNumber)

name: D41 an edit is sent as a new post
guards: streaming a turn edits one message instead of flooding the channel
from:
method: edit === null ? "POST" : "PATCH",
      path: edit === null ? `channels/

name: D42 a non-snowflake message id reaches the path
guards: an edit id is refused before a socket opens

name: D43 the REST base drops to v9
guards: every route is under /api/v10/

name: D44 a bot token is presented as Bearer
guards: Discord's bot scheme is Bot, and Bearer is refused 401

name: D45 verification is skipped for well-formed bodies
guards: verification runs before anything reads the body, so an unsigned body is refused in the use case

name: C01 channel-discord is listed as unimplemented
guards: rule (C7) joins UNIMPLEMENTED_ADAPTERS to the directory's own source in both directions

name: C02 the Discord construction arm never builds the adapter
guards: a declared channels.discord group produces a constructed channel-discord

name: C03 the ChannelRuntime satisfaction obligation is dropped
guards: every declared binding is proven at compile time

name: C04 the discord-sdk-only home points at the wrong directory
guards: Discord's client libraries have exactly one home in the V1 tree

name: C05 the channel ports lose their multi-home entries
guards: a second home for a port is refused unless declared

name: C06 the public-key grammar admits a suffix
guards: a key with a stray tail is refused at boot rather than truncated into the genuine key

name: C07 the Discord group assembles the replay window from the wrong variable
guards: each declared default survives the real loader

name: D46 a 429 naming no bucket leaves its route free
guards: a refusal with no X-RateLimit-Bucket still holds the next call on that route before a socket opens (verifier round 1 V3)

name: D47 a thread with no parent_id is keyed under an absent parent
guards: a thread-typed channel without parent_id is keyed on itself (verifier round 1 V4)

name: D48 the sweep deletes live windows too
guards: a window that has not reset survives a sweep (verifier round 1 V7, on the round 2 table shape)

name: D49 the sweep never runs
guards: the tables are bounded at all

name: D50 the sweep is started by windows alone, as before round 2
guards: route entries count towards the bound, so one per interaction token cannot grow unswept

name: D51 route entries are never swept
guards: a followup route nothing live stands behind is forgotten (the round 2 leak restored)

name: D52 the sweep drops the route that finds a live window
guards: a route whose (credential, bucket) group still has a live window keeps its bucket, so the window still refuses

name: D53 expired global blocks are never swept
guards: a reset global block is forgotten by a sweep

name: D54 the sweep drops a live global block
guards: a global block that has not reset survives a sweep
